name: bm-star
description: C→S bm.star (protocol 1.6, D-10): bookmark that tab's URL into the bookmarks-bar root. `tabId` is an INTEGER (a chrome.tabs id), unlike bm.open/bm.remove's string `nodeId`. Fire-and-forget — no err reply; the next bm.changed reconciles the optimistic star (D-12). No url crosses the wire: the extension resolves the tab's URL locally.
